editorial_note: First scheduled run of 2026-09-24. Result NO_QUALIFYING_STORY, but the reason changed from prior runs: discovery/verification is no longer the binding constraint. Outbound WebFetch reached WOSU (wosu.org), the City of Worthington official project page (worthington.org/802/Boundless-Harding-Hospital-Site), Yahoo News, and the Wikimedia Commons API this run. The top real-estate lead (the Worthington 'Democracy Before Developers' referendum petition against the July 20, 2026 rezoning of the former Harding Hospital / I Am Boundless site at 445 E. Dublin-Granville Road / SR-161) is FULLY VERIFIED across a primary record and two independent origins: the City of Worthington primary page (~20.4 acres; S-1 to PUD; Municipal Planning Commission recommended 4-1 on 2026-06-25; City Council approved the Preliminary Plan 2026-07-20; 246 apartments + 2 single-family homes = 248 total dwelling units at ~12.2 du/acre; developer Elford Development; 10-year 75% tax abatement via the Workforce Housing Program with 74 units (30%) at 80% AMI), WOSU (nearly 4,000 signatures submitted Friday 2026-09-20, validation expected mid-October 2026, organizer Marty Shumway, city statement referencing Elford), and Yahoo aggregation (3,976 signatures, 3,017 required at a 35% threshold, $52.4M). The story is held for ONE reason only: NEEDS_IMAGE. No rights-cleared, publicly-redistributable, story-matching documentary photograph is obtainable, and the cloud handoff bars paid/AI generation and stock placeholders, so no truthful cloud_image_asset receipt can accompany a draft. Wikimedia Commons 'Harding Hospital Worthington Ohio' returned 3 results, none the site (a George Tryon Harding II portrait and two unrelated Ohio sanitariums); 'Worthington Ohio' returned only 1938-1948 historic streetscapes and churches, none the site and failing both story_match and freshness; the City page shows renderings/plan exhibits, not a redistributable photograph, and website display is not public-redistribution permission. Recorded discrepancies to reconcile before any future drafting: (1) unit count is 246 apartments + 2 single-family homes per the primary record, not '248 apartments'; (2) signature threshold is stated as ~3,000 (WOSU) vs 3,017 at 35% (Yahoo/social), to be pinned to the Franklin County Board of Elections / Worthington clerk; (3) the road is E. Dublin-Granville Road (SR-161). This receipt records the editorial outcome only and is not publication authority; no import, image preparation, email delivery, or publication is claimed, and no git commit is treated as publication or downstream-import success.
